Eating it will temporarily increase your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Carps are a type of [[Frozen Food]], and they can be made by exposing [[Mighty Carp]], [[Armored Carp]], or [[Sanke Carp]] to [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Their icy texture makes them a delicacy. Eating one will restore one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and grant him temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Carps reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by exposing [[Mighty Carp]], [[Armored Carp]], or [[Sanke Carp]] to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Due to their icy texture, they are considered a delicacy. When Link eats a Frozen Carp, he will heal one [[Heart]] and receive one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Carp * Food * Frozen Food * Roasted Carp }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
